text: Retail sales, industrial output, and fixed asset investments undershot expectations in April. Property investment contraction deepened while export growth accelerated. Producer prices rose faster than consumer prices. Domestic consumption stimulus showed limited expansion while trade coordination mechanisms between the U.S. and China remained active.

meta.note: Export strength and domestic weakness operate simultaneously without convergent settlement.

text: Lululemon publicly opposed founder Chip Wilson's board nominees after settlement talks collapsed. Competing director slates were presented ahead of the annual meeting. The company defended existing leadership and incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill while citing governance, expertise, and competitor-alignment concerns regarding Wilson-backed nominees.

meta.note: Control contest spans governance, creative direction, and operational authority simultaneously.

text: NextEra Energy agreed to acquire Dominion Energy in an all-stock transaction valued at nearly $67 billion. The combined company will integrate renewable, natural gas, nuclear, and regulated utility infrastructure under a single operating structure. Northern Virginia data center power capacity and nationwide generation expansion plans were consolidated within the merged entity.

meta.note: Utility regulation, generation mix, and AI infrastructure demand converge within one transaction structure.

text: The Trump administration and DOJ established a $1.776 billion "Anti-Weaponization Fund" in exchange for dismissal of a $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS. Court review regarding jurisdiction and adversity between parties was bypassed through voluntary dismissal. Public officials and advocacy groups issued competing claims regarding the legality and constitutional standing of the arrangement.

meta.note: Executive, judicial, and compensatory authorities overlap without resolved procedural hierarchy.

text: Kevin Warsh will assume the Federal Reserve chair position following Senate confirmation and the expiration of Jerome Powell's term. The administration publicly associated the transition with expectations for resumed rate cuts, while market pricing continued to reflect elevated inflation conditions and delayed easing expectations. Powell remained in a pro-tempore role pending formal transfer.

meta.note: Formal authority transfer and market-policy expectation divergence coexist during interim operational overlap.
